biblical_reference.verse_reference: And Simeon had two sons, named Timon, and Timon by another wife, his wife's name was Rhoda. She was a woman of the city of Joppa, and she was a disciple of Peter. And as Peter traveled through all those regions, he came down also to the saints in Lydda.
biblical_reference.note: Philippine (daughter of a man named Timon) was a disciple of Peter and was healed by him of a demon. This is the only mention of this name in the New Testament.
